p: Ariel: Or Ariel: the Hebrew word Ariel signifies the Lion of God, and signifies the Altar, because the altar seemed to devour the sacrifice that was offered to God, as in Eze 43:16.
let them kill sacrifices: Your vain confidence in your sacrifices will not last long.
as Ariel: Your city will be full of blood as an altar on which they sacrifice.
ground: Your speech will be no longer be so lofty but abased and low as the very charmers who are in low places and whisper, so that their voice can scarcely by heard.
strangers shall be like small dust: Your hired soldiers in whom you trusted, will be destroyed as dust or chaff in a whirlwind.

multitude of all the nations that: The enemies that I will bring to destroy you, and that which you place your vain trust in will come at unawares even as a dream in the night. Some read as if this was a comfort to the Church for the destruction of their enemies.
he eateth: That is, he thinks that he eats.
Stay yourselves: Muse on this a long as ye like, yet you will find nothing but opportunity to be astonished for your prophets are blind, and therefore cannot direct you.
cannot: Meaning, that it is all alike, either to read, or not to read, unless God open the heart to understand.
draw near me with their mouth: Because they are hypocrites and not sincere in heart, as in Mt 15:7,8.
fear toward me is taught by: That is, their religion was learned by man's doctrine, and not by my word.
perish: Meaning, where God is not worshipped according to his word, both magistrates and ministers are fools and without understanding.
seek deep to hide their counsel: This is spoken of them who in heart despised God's word, and mocked at the admonitions but outwardly bore a good face.
as the potter's clay: For all your craft says the Lord, you are not able to escape my hands any more than the clay that is in the potter's hands has power to deliver itself.

turned into a fruitful field: Will there not be a change of all things? Carmel is a plentiful place in respect to what it will be then and may be taken for a forest, as in Isa 32:15 and thus he speaks to comfort the faithful.
word: They who went about to find fault with the prophets words, and would not abide admonitions, but would entangle them and bring them into danger.
shall come to understanding: Signifying that unless God gives understanding and knowledge, man cannot but still err and murmur against him.
